```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(rsample)
library(yardstick)

league_df <- read_csv("data/laser_league_players.csv") %>%
  mutate(
    high_glow = if_else(glow_rating >= 8, 1, 0)
  )

set.seed(123)
split <- initial_split(league_df, prop = 0.75)
train_df <- training(split)
test_df <- testing(split)
```

```{r}
reg_model <- lm(
  season_score ~ matches_played + assists + tag_accuracy_pct + shield_uptime_pct,
  data = train_df
)
reg_predictions <- predict(reg_model, newdata = test_df)
rmse_value <- rmse_vec(test_df$season_score, reg_predictions)
rmse_value
```

```{r}
log_model <- glm(
  high_glow ~ matches_played + tag_accuracy_pct + shield_uptime_pct,
  data = train_df,
  family = binomial()
)
class_probs <- predict(log_model, newdata = test_df, type = "response")
predicted_class <- if_else(class_probs > 0.5, "Yes", "No")
actual_class <- if_else(test_df$high_glow == 1, "Yes", "No")

eval_confusion <- table(Predicted = predicted_class, Actual = actual_class)
eval_confusion
precision_val <- eval_confusion["Yes", "Yes"] / sum(eval_confusion["Yes", ])
recall_val <- eval_confusion["Yes", "Yes"] / sum(eval_confusion[, "Yes"])
precision_val
recall_val
```
